Marco, Dominic, Emily and Nic did a phenomenal job! They left the bathroom spotless and were super friendly and informative from start to finish! Consultant was very helpful and thorough in her presentation.
Carlos, Micellar, The contractors Eddie Rodriguez and his entire crew were fabulous! I have already recommended them to 3 people

David Elms did a wonderful job installing our new Jacuzzi shower grab bar. He explained things throughout the process and was very friendly. He cleaned up after himself very thoroughly. We couldn’t have asked for anyone better. Priscilla Garcia dis a wonderful job setting everything up.

Beautiful work.  Chelsea, Project Manager, was a pleasure to work with. Donte, our installer, was professional and efficient.  We had two bathrooms updated and both were finished in two days.  Job well done.  Thank you.
Marty was very thorough and professional. He was happy to answer all of our questions, made some terrific suggestions, and helped us understand our options. Very friendly and helpful.
Zintex was amazing to work with. Brandon did an amazing job on the installation. Tom and Matt were amazing to work with. 100% recommend!
Perfect I can say more

It was amazing. The help was so great making sure everything was moved and covered so nothing was messed up. They Worked like an orchestra.  So percercise. Again thank you for everything it was so perfect.
Rigo Rosas did a good and quick job also asked if we were satisfied.

Vern Jackson and Mikel Hall did a great job. They worked very well together as a team and finished our project in a much shorter timeframe than anticipated. I had a great installation experience! The install crew was really professional and knowledgeable about the product and the installation process. There was an unforseen repair and the crew and Supervisor resolved without any conflicts. I would highly recommend this weekend install crew and Supervisor for a professional experience.
Samuel and his crew did a splendid job.  They were friendly and professional, and they got the entire job done in a single day.  I highly recommend these workers.
He was very knowledgeable and easy to understand even if you declined the financing for a senior citizen! A shower replacement was all I was looking for and a little overpriced for a simple job.

Christian was so meticulous with every detail of our shower install. I wouldn’t hesitate for a minute recommending him in the future. Our shower is beautiful and he made sure it was installed perfectly. Such a great job and a quality product.

Fantastic tub to shower remodel! Our installer, Fidel was awesome! He was careful, courteous, and very meticulous in his work. Kept the area organized and as tidy as a remodel can be in progress.
Our project manager Rebecca Ikenberg was on top of things and kept us informed of how the project was progressing. The whole team was great to work with. Including the salesman Jim Wilson who took time to walk us through the process and showed us progress photos.
I had a excellent installer very good. And Chelsea was excellent at keeping us up to date

We had our tub transformed into a walk in shower. It is so beautiful!! We are well pleased. Emily, the project mgr was very nice and was there anytime we had questions. The installers were polite and very respectful. Thank you Zintex!!
Cindy Odom was great in every aspect of helping me select my bathroom remodel. I am also pleased with the services of Rebecca and Dakota.
Good installers!

I called Monday morning to let customer service know that I had a mold issue that needed to be taken care of as soon as possible. This was the only issue I've had in the three years since they did the remodel.  They called me back that afternoon and had me scheduled for Wednesday morning the same week.  My tech Phillip called Tuesday afternoon to let me know he'd be there between 10-10:30 Wednesday morning and he would let me know when he was 10 minutes away.  He arrived on time, was professional and very personable.  I was very impressed with the outcome and reaction time to my issue.  I strongly recommend Zintec for your bathroom remodeling needs.  They truly stand behind their promises and products... fantastic customer service!!
Communication between Chelsea at Zintec and installer David was wonderful in getting exactly what we wanted with our shower remodel. High quality products and very fast to install. Took just 3 days.

I love my new walk in tub and shower! Tyson and Moses did a great job installing it and cleaning up afterwards. I would recommend these two men to anyone. They were very professional and easy to work with. They went above and beyond anything I expected.
Great job!! Very happy with him!!
Very professional.  Incredibly kind and informative. A joy to have
I was always provided up dates. Mike the installer was very professional and timely. Mike craftsmanship was outstanding.
Enjoyed our experience with Terry Anderson of Zintex. Very detailed in explaining so many things having to do with our project. Can't  wait!
Had my main  bath remodeled to a Jacuzzi bath by Zintex contractor Adrian Bryan. He was very professional and good to have this remodel done. We are very happy with his work.

Our time spent with Zintex was outstanding they professional and friendly.  It all started with Jon the sales rep. he gave us complete details of what to expect.  Jon took his time to help us understand all of those upgrade details.  We
were later contacted by Priscilla our contact at their office.  She did a great job keeping us informed of the planning stages and to just say hello.  Then there was Justin the installer.  He was very professional and friendly.  If we had questions along the way he answered them.  It was amazing the attention to detail these professionals took.  We are very impressed by the Zintex company.

Simply amazing..A job well done in a timely manner. The technicians were very nice guys. ZinTex is the way to go if you’re in need for bathroom renovation.
Christian, the instillation person appear to be very professional with a great demeanor and much appreciated throughout the whole process during offered services.  Thanks!
Good salesman. Respectful and understanding.
Great guys, professional in all aspects of the job. Made sure it was exactly what we wanted and expected
Brian and Brandon were polite and professional!! Cleaned up every day, finished on time. Beautiful job!

Byron was the salesman that helped me and he was great and so helpful. He put in a lot of time and energy. Cindy - thank you for keeping in touch with me through the process. And Daniel did a great job installing. I’m so happy with how my shower turned out.
Brad (?) was great! He stuck to his work and did a great install AND some helpful hints for maintenance. He also reminded us of the lifetime waranty.

The process to have our project assessed, contact with our project manager Rebecca, through demolition and installation by Vern and Mike was effortless. The day of installation was as promised, installers were wonderful, arrived on time, reviewed the project, how each stage would progress etc. Vern and Mike involved us each step of the way. So pleased with our new walk in shower. Highly recommend Zintex.
Great work, completed quickly and accurately, and very clean!

Salesman (Brad) was very friendly and informative. Knew his “stuff”. Installer (Jason) was also very personable and worked hard to get everything done correctly.

Very professional and using utmost care to keep walk ways clean.

The installation guys showed up bright and early and got busy. They worked diligently until late into the evening so they could finish the job. I very pleased with their results!
I'm  so excited about our new walk in shower.  It is awesome it looks really good.

I had Zintex put in a new shower after my wife 2 strokes back in November 2025. The install team was amazing as well as all the chain of command. you get what you pay for and that's a quality they back up with superior products and workmanship,  coupled with a lifetime warranty and that means the world to me.Thank you Mirella and Zintex.
Install went great. Love my new walk in shower. Rebecca was a great help too.
Very professional Josiah was wonderful and Kate was helpful throughout the process I loved working with them and will let all my friends know how happy we are. Thank you Josiah and Kate
